description: Baseline capabilities: main + audience windows can manage their lifecycle, emit/listen events, query monitors, open external URLs via the OS, read deck files the user explicitly chose via dialog or file-association, write files to paths the user picked in a native save dialog (edited-copy / PDF export), show native message / ask / confirm dialogs (Check for Updates menu trigger, unsaved-edits exit guard), and run the in-app auto-updater (download + signature-verified install + relaunch).
